name: OpenStreetMap
description: OpenStreetMap is a collaborative project to create a free, editable map of the world. It allows users to view, edit, and use geographical data in a collaborative way from anywhere on Earth.

events.d: Create a map note at a specified latitude and longitude with the provided text.
Find notes by ID or within a map area. Optionally filter by open/closed status, closed date range, or limit the number of results.
Adds a comment to a note and returns the updated note and the new comment.
Close or reopen a map note and optionally add a comment.
Delete a note by its ID, optionally including a comment or reason.
